description: Swiss building stock heat demand data by typology, raster summary is a data set deposited in ethz.genfyareta by its authors Jonathan Chambers. Swiss building stock physical characteristics and heat demands data disaggregated by building typology. The values are summarised on a raster grid of 200m x 200m pixels. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. Formats: JSON, CSV, Image, TXT, XML. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
name: Swiss building stock heat demand data by typology, raster summary
